root_cause.text: The `net_shaper_nl_get_doit()` and `net_shaper_nl_cap_get_doit()` functions in the net-shapers subsystem cause a double-free vulnerability by invoking `nlmsg_free()` on the reply `sk_buff` after `genlmsg_reply()` has already transferred ownership of the buffer to the netlink subsystem.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that `genlmsg_reply()` hands the reply skb to netlink and `netlink_unicast()` consumes it on all return paths, while the patch diff shows the removal of the error path jump to `free_msg` (which calls `nlmsg_free(msg)`) that previously occurred after `genlmsg_reply()` failed.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement is called in the free_msg cleanup path (lines 764-766) after genlmsg_reply() has already transferred ownership of msg to the netlink subsystem (line 762). When genlmsg_reply() succeeds, it takes ownership of the sk_buff, so calling nlmsg_free() afterward causes a double-free vulnerability. This matches the root cause description where nlmsg_free() is incorrectly invoked after genlmsg_reply() has taken ownership.
